run_instruct_pix2pix_pipeline: run the StableDiffusionInstructPix2PixPipeline to edit an image by following a text prompt instruction
encode_prompt_for_pix2pix: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings for the InstructPix2Pix pipeline
prepare_image_latents: prepare and encode input image latents from a PIL image or tensor for the pipeline
load_lora_weights: load LoRA weights into the InstructPix2Pix pipeline to fine-tune image editing behavior
load_ip_adapter: load an IP Adapter into the InstructPix2Pix pipeline for image-to-image style transfer
